summary: Smoke-regression of the iter_19 frontend cleanup (removed unused useMemo / getApiToken imports, unused corpusResult state destructure, and unused spansByFile constant). Ran Playwright against the preview URL. App boots cleanly with zero console errors; Wizard Step 1 renders (Upload heading + IRB torture panel + Enable toggle + dropzone); enabling corpus toggle reveals preset dropdown, row-count input, and 'Launch adversarial run' button; POST /api/corpus/study/run succeeds and clicking 'Watch the corpus run' navigates to /studies/{sid}?corpus=1; SessionDetail renders status-chip, hero heading 'Working on it.', and agent-trace-panel with the '0 agent call(s) · 0.0 s of LLM time' header; STOP button (data-testid=btn-cancel-run) is visible for running session and flips to 'Cancel pending…' after click; Settings page loads with token input; no JS or React runtime errors were emitted at any step. Pipeline completion / corpus-verifier-panel were intentionally NOT awaited (per review request).

issues: Route renders a blank canvas (only PHI Console header) when no session context is bound; LiveCounters is a child that only renders inside an active session. Pre-existing behavior, NOT caused by the spansByFile removal — no console errors, component code path is intact. Consider a placeholder/empty-state message on /corpus so operators aren't staring at an empty page.

action_items: None required for iter_19 scope — all six unused-var removals are safe and non-breaking.
Optional (pre-existing): add empty-state UI to /corpus route when no session is selected so LiveCounters context is obvious.
critical_code_review_comments: Wizard.jsx uses `const [, setCorpusResult] = useState(null);` — the destructure-only-setter pattern is fine but the accompanying comment says the setter is 'kept for a future summary panel'. If that panel never lands, the state itself can be dropped entirely (state writes with no readers are a code smell).
SessionDetail.jsx still imports getApiToken from ../lib/api (used inside downloadBundle). Import list is correct — do NOT remove.

AgentSection.jsx defines a second component that also uses data-testid='agent-trace-panel' (line 193) which collides with SessionDetail's AgentTracePanel testid. Not exercised in current flow but a Playwright selector on that testid would be ambiguous if both mount on the same route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter_19 cleanup verified: corpus toggle → launch → navigate → SessionDetail → agent-trace-panel → STOP button → Cancel pending flow all work with zero console errors. Preview URL: https://quality-enhance-9.preview.emergentagent.com. The webpack ESLint warning about 'corpusResult never used' shown earlier in supervisor logs is from a stale compile before the destructure-out was picked up; the currently-served bundle compiles clean. corpus-verifier-panel was intentionally not exercised (would require a 3+ min pipeline run). If needed, POST /api/corpus/study/run + poll GET /api/sessions/{sid} until status=complete, then reload /studies/{sid}?corpus=1 and assert [data-testid='corpus-verifier-panel'].
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. The iter_19 changes are pure dead-code removal; render output and behavior are unchanged.
